*Activates the Entrance Animation upon the character's entry*
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}Ki +3, ATK & DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g} and great chance of
launching an additional Super Attack
- {passiveImg:once}Guards all attacks for 4 turns

- ATK & DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Receives an additional Ki +3 per TEQ Ki Sphere obtained
- Receives an additional Ki +2 per non-TEQ Ki Sphere obtained
- Damage reduction rate 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
- "DAIMA" or "Vegeta's Family" Category allies' ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When activating the Active Skill or when attacking with 23 or more Ki*
- Damage reduction rate 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
*For every attack performed*
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g} within the turn
*Every time the character performs 3 or more attacks in battle*
- Launches an additional Super Attack (up to once within a turn)
- All allies' chance of performing a critical hit 50%{passiveImg:up_g} within the
character's next attacking turn (up to 50% within a turn)
*Starting from the 4th turn from the start of battle*
- All allies' DEF 20%{passiveImg:up_g} and Super Class "DAIMA" Category allies
guard all attacks for 2 turns when the character is the 2nd to obtain
Ki Spheres in a turn
- All allies' DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g} and Super Class "DAIMA" Category allies
guard all attacks for 3 turns when the character is the 3rd to obtain
Ki Spheres in a turn
